page.overview:
What is Castle?

Castle is a theme introduced in 2007. The theme was often referred to as "Fantasy Era" or "Fantasy Castle" by fans to avoid confusion with the original Castle theme that was introduced in 1978. The theme ran until 2010, when it was replaced with Kingdoms.

The theme mainly focuses on fantasy creatures such as trolls and dwarves, and pits humans against various evil creatures instead of an opposing faction of other human beings. Most sets contained warriors from two opposing factions in order to increase playability. The first protagonists of the human faction were known as the Crown knights, who fought the Skeleton Warriors led by an Evil Wizard, who appeared in the first year of the theme. In 2008, the trolls arose as new foes, who were also enemies of the newly added Dwarves. In 2009 only three new sets were released, including 10193 Medieval Market Village which is known to be the most intricate work of European styled buildings ever released by LEGO at the time.

4850307 LEGO Battles prominently features Castle, with the King and Wizard being heroes of their respective story campaigns. The theme also appears in My LEGO Network as stickers and backgrounds. The Western Kingdom's crown emblem is prominently featured in 55000 LEGO Universe media.

The Western Kingdom is the main heroic faction that represents the humans, introduced in 2007. Their coat of arms is a crown superimposed on a blue background as seen on their shields, flags and uniforms; therefore, they were unofficially known as the "Crown Knights" by LEGO fans, which later became officially adopted by LEGO media starting with Standing Small: A Celebration of 30 Years of the LEGO Minifigure. The faction is led by Crown King Brutus and based at the King's Castle. Other buildings include a tower, a fortified port, and a fortified drawbridge. The Western Kingdom does not have any vehicles other than a chariot, but they do have two siege engines: a catapult and a crossbow. The Crown Knights not only use horses as mounts but dragons as well, as seen in 7048 Troll Warship. This faction features a complete royal family with Crown King Brutus, the Crown Queen, and Princess Alyssa, as well as Prince Varen in 2854298 LEGO: The Adventures of Clutch Powers. The court also encompasses a Good Wizard, Jester Gogo, the Lead General, and the Golden Knight.
